name: Panama City
summary: Panama City combines a financial skyscraper next to the Canal with a dollarized economy that eliminates currency exchange risk. The territorial tax system does not tax income from foreign sources, and the country has a real digital nomad visa (minimum income of $3,000/month, initial validity of about 9 months, renewable). The seafront of the city itself is not a beach suitable for bathing - the real beaches are 15-20 minutes away at Playa Kobbe or Amador - and security is only moderate in some areas.
